verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring automation is a fair axis for an API-driven video platform, but the evidence shows only one-off asynchronous jobs submitted via the Video API, with polling or webhook notifications on completion. Nothing documents a native recurring schedule, cron-style trigger, or scheduled workflow. Running a job once is not the same as a recurring schedule, and an external scheduler calling the API would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
